title: Generous + Obelisk
problem: Generous copies are Ethereal gems, so Obelisk's text says they keep full charges while Generous's text says they have only 1. The code follows Generous: the 'shared gem -> 1 charge' rule runs after Obelisk.
notes: Text: Your creatures' [temporary] Ethereal Spell Gems have the same number of {STAT_charges} they'd have if they weren't Ethereal. | At the start of battle, your other creatures gain an ... Evidence: inv_SpellGemsUpdate L210-L221 (Ethereal x0.25 unless Obelisk 1195 @0x141db9770 / 0x141db9829); L253-L254 @0x141db9f82 shared == true -> charges_max = 1; Generous copies shared = true in bc_StartupGems @0x1416ce59d. Fix sketch: L_TRAIT_DESC_OBELISK: "Your creatures' [temporary] Ethereal Spell Gems have the same number of {STAT_charges} they'd have if they weren't Ethereal. Generous copies still have only 1 {STAT_charge}." Reasoning: Two game texts contradict for Generous copies; the code follows the Generous text, so Obelisk's text is corrected (ruling 2). App note (unpatched game): Obelisk does not affect Generous copies: they always have 1 charge. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26). | 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module).

text_fix.en_proposed: Your creatures' [temporary] Ethereal Spell Gems have the same number of {STAT_charges} they'd have if they weren't Ethereal. Copies created by Generous still have only 1 {STAT_charge}.

release_notes.intended: Ethereal Spell Gems keep their normal charges.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, Obelisk's text contradicted Generous: Generous copies always have only 1 charge, even with Obelisk.
release_notes.fix: Now Obelisk's text says Generous copies keep 1 charge.
